title: Un continente industrial
goal: Read a closing balance of import substitution's real achievement by the 1960s against its structural limits -- imported-technology dependence, uneven regional development, and growing foreign debt.

items: State what had happened to the region's industrial capacity by the mid-1960s.
Explain the structural problem economists pointed to despite this achievement.
Describe whether industrial development was distributed evenly across the region.
Explain how many governments financed industrialization, and the risk involved.
Use pese a que + subjunctive to honor a real achievement while naming its limits.
